finalText:
**Redis died and took the whole service with it.**

```
02:14:07  redis at 10.0.0.12:6379 refuses connections
02:14:07  cache switched off, reads go straight to the store
02:14–02:31  every read times out at 5s, backlog grows
02:29:12  backlog passes its limit of 500, hits 502
02:31:44  worker-2 runs out of memory, restarted
02:31:52  supervisor kills the api, service down
```

The error was `ECONNREFUSED`. That means Redis was not listening at all. The app retried 13 times over 16 minutes. Every retry was refused the same way. First error to dead service: 17 minutes, 45 seconds.

Nothing recovers until Redis is back up.

One oddity. This log is dated July 4, not last night.
